description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Center functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It verifies creating, retrieving, updating, deleting centers, and related operations like group and staff assignments, using JUnit and REST API calls.

classes.name: CenterIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains multiple JUnit test methods for verifying the behavior of Center-related functionalities such as creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and associations within the Fineract integration tests.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured settings and prepares request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: testBasicCenterCreation
methods.description: Tests the basic creation of a center and verifies it can be retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testFullCenterCreation
methods.description: Tests creating a center with additional details like external ID, staff, and group members, and verifies proper attribute assignment.

methods.name: testListCenters
methods.description: Checks the listing and paginated listing of centers for consistency.

methods.name: testVoidCenterRetrieval
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a non-existing center and expects a 404 response.

methods.name: testCenterUpdate
methods.description: Updates center details and verifies the changes are persisted correctly.

methods.name: testCenterDeletion
methods.description: Tests center deletion and verifies the center cannot be retrieved afterward.

methods.name: generateGroupMembers
methods.description: Helper method to create and associate group members for a center.

methods.name: testStaffAssignmentDuringCenterCreation
methods.description: Verifies assigning a staff to a center during creation.

methods.name: testAssignStaffToCenter
methods.description: Tests assigning a staff member to an existing center.

methods.name: testUnassignStaffToCenter
methods.description: Verifies unassigning staff from a center.

methods.name: testCentersOrphanGroups
methods.description: Verifies the handling of orphaned groups after center deletion.
